item.title: github: Public monitoring adds triage, validity, API, and webhooks
item.description:
Public monitoring now includes alert management features for handling leaked secrets at scale. The update adds validity checks, dismissals, timelines, filtering, plus API and webhook support.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Public monitoring now available with data residency
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency now supports public monitoring in public preview. This extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories to monitor public content.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Updates to GitHub secret scanning
item.description:
GitHub announced updates to secret scanning, including changes to audit log events and bug fixes. The notice specifically mentions a November 12, 2026 change to the business field in affected secret_scanning_alert.* and secret_scanning_push_protection.bypass audit log events.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning blocks Anthropic keys by default, adds Salesforce
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now detects new secret types for Salesforce, Anthropic, and Cloudsmith. Anthropic keys are blocked with push protection by default.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning adds detectors for Lovable, Supabase, and more
item.description:
GitHub Secret Scanning added new detectors for secrets from Lovable Labs, Pydantic Services Inc., and Supabase. A new provider also joined the secret scanning partnership program.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning coverage updates
item.description:
GitHub updated secret scanning coverage by adding more secrets to push protection, onboarding a new secret scanning partner, and including richer metadata in alerts. The post also notes the Secret Scanning Partnership Program now includes Lovable Labs.

  • Source: GitHub
